commands.name: clean-prompt
commands.title: Clean Prompt
commands.subtitle: Zenkai
commands.description: Tidies the selected text or clipboard as a prompt: normalizes line endings, converts tabs, strips trailing whitespace and collapses extra blank lines, leaving code fences untouched.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
